ImageDescription.value: Deputy Secretary of Defense Ashton B. Carter and former Secretary of Defense William Perry sit down for a meeting with Theranos CEO and founder Elizabeth Holmes as they pay a visit to several high tech companies in Palo Alto, California, April 17, 2013.
